description: SP-08 allow (Claude Code 2.1.301), 15 §1.3, §1.4, §4.2: the prompt's turn as the driver reads it on stdout. The permission request itself went to the prompt tool, not to stdout, so the driver sees only the Write tool step: activity started, then finished at its tool_result. Each assistant message.id is one sealed usage unit (the first sealed when the next message.id starts, the last by the result line); the result record ends the turn once, reliable, then status idle. The rate_limit_event status allowed_warning and the system notification add nothing.

script.prompt: Use the Write tool to create a file named sp08-allow-marker.txt in the current folder, containing the single word marker. Do not use any other tool. Then reply with the single word done.
